test: one deterministic nominal DLS pick-and-place with per-step collision/contact monitoring

episode.sim_time_scope: MuJoCo simulation clock; excludes wall-clock rendering and planning interpretation
episode.episode_wall_time_scope: wall-clock duration for the full episode, including IK solves and simulation steps

collision_audit.measurement_scope: post-step scene monitor; exact mj_geomDistance query for each listed geom pair at every physics step
collision_audit.contact_observation_definition: one pair observation per physics step with a MuJoCo contact record
collision_audit.distinct_contact_event_definition: transition into dist<=0 for a geom pair after a step without that pair in actual contact

expected_contact_exclusions.cube_geom<->worktable: allowed during approach, descend, close_gripper, lower_place, release, and retreat; during lift only while the cube remains within 6 mm of its geometric support height; transfer-phase table contact is unexpected
expected_contact_exclusions.cube_geom<->finger surfaces: left/right pad boxes and left/right follower tongue meshes; allowed phases close_gripper, lift, transfer, lower_place, release; counted separately
expected_contact_exclusions.tray: no tray geometry exists; no tray contacts or clearances are measured
